title: Well-posedness of a generalized Stokes operator on domains with cylindrical ends via layer-potentials
summary: We study the \emph{generalized Stokes operator} \begin{equation*} \bsXi \ede \bsXi _{V,V_0} \ede \left(\begin{array}{ccc} \bsL + V & \nabla \\ \nabla^* & -V_0 \end{array}\right) \end{equation*} on a \emph{domain with straight cylindrical ends} $Ω$ using \emph{the method of layer potentials} on $M \supset Ω$. The operator $\bsXi_{0, 0}$ is the classical Stokes operator. Under suitable positivity assumptions on $V$ and $V_{0}$, we prove that $\bsXi$ is Fredholm.
